title: gregllm
tagline: A Claude Code skill that answers "what will this GregTech: New Horizons build cost?" down to raw materials.
highlights: Expands multiblocks and batch crafts over real GTNH 2.9.0 recipe data (~93 MB) into raw materials, EU/t, duration and total EU
Picks the cheapest recipe chain under your voltage tier, then Claude confirms each choice with you
Downloads the recipe data on first run and verifies it against a pinned hash; no npm dependencies
Plan files pin recipe choices so a cost breakdown can be reproduced
